tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background under the corner blooms. Never used for cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, modals, fields. Content always sits on crisp white.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Footers of cards (shortcut strip), inner panels such as the verdict box, hover on table rows.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Sidebar and properties rail, with a 16px backdrop blur over the blooms.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards: table rows, card headers, tab strip bottom.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Field and checkbox borders, dashed empty-state outlines. 3:1 against surface is not met: pair with a label.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface and canvas (17:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: table cells, step lists, run output (10:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text and hints (7.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: IDs, timestamps, counts, column headers (5.3:1 on surface, 5:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons (white text 5.1:1), focus rings, active tab underline, progress, selected radio. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Links, hovered primary buttons, accent-coloured text (6.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows in menus and the command palette, verify buttons.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Hover on menu items and tabs, selected table rows.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, success and toast fills.

tokens.name: bloom-sky
tokens.usage: Top-left corner bloom (at 50% alpha) and the bar in the logo mark.

tokens.name: bloom-pink
tokens.usage: Top-right corner bloom (at 45% alpha).

tokens.name: bloom-sun
tokens.usage: Bottom-right corner bloom (at 38% alpha).

tokens.name: bloom-mint
tokens.usage: Bottom-left corner bloom (at 38% alpha).

tokens.name: status-spec
tokens.usage: Spec'd glyph: dashed empty circle.

tokens.name: status-open
tokens.usage: Open or to-do glyph: empty circle. Also pending run steps.

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: In progress glyph: half-filled circle.

tokens.name: status-review
tokens.usage: In review glyph: three-quarter circle. Also 'fixed, awaiting check'.

tokens.name: status-returned
tokens.usage: Returned glyph: circle with a back chevron. Also failed runs.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Accepted glyph: filled circle with a white check.

tokens.name: ratio-pass
tokens.usage: Passed share of a ratio bar; public tests share of a test-count bar.

tokens.name: ratio-fail
tokens.usage: Failed share of a ratio bar.

tokens.name: ratio-sealed
tokens.usage: Sealed (hidden) share: hatched with ratio-sealed-light at 135 degrees, 3px stripes.

tokens.name: ratio-sealed-light
tokens.usage: Second stripe of the sealed hatch.

tokens.name: ratio-track
tokens.usage: Empty track behind a ratio bar.

tokens.name: mark-neutral
tokens.usage: Mark for 'all roles' and other neutral kinds.

tokens.name: mark-advisory
tokens.usage: Mark for advisory findings and the chore label.

tokens.name: mark-blocking
tokens.usage: Mark for blocking findings and 'test gaming'.

tokens.name: label-bug
tokens.usage: Label mark: bug.

tokens.name: label-feature
tokens.usage: Label mark: feature.

tokens.name: label-perf
tokens.usage: Label mark: perf.

tokens.name: label-security
tokens.usage: Label mark: security.

tokens.name: project-sky
tokens.usage: Project square (8px): first project.

tokens.name: project-pink
tokens.usage: Project square: second project.

tokens.name: project-amber
tokens.usage: Project square: third project.

tokens.name: role-author
tokens.usage: Author role glyph (pen).

tokens.name: role-implementer
tokens.usage: Implementer role glyph (brackets).

tokens.name: role-reviewer
tokens.usage: Reviewer role glyph (eye).

tokens.name: text-success
tokens.usage: 'Pass', 'read' and other positive words in text (6.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: text-danger
tokens.usage: Errors, Close issue, round 6 of 6, danger buttons (6.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: text-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings in text (6.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Accept button fill (on-accent text 5:1).

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Inline alert background, danger button hover.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Inline alert and danger button border.

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the bulk-action bar: the only dark surfaces, always small and floating.

tokens.name: toast-link
tokens.usage: Undo and other actions inside a toast (9.8:1 on toast).

tokens.name: redaction
tokens.usage: Redaction bars for sealed content (striped with redaction-light).

tokens.name: redaction-light
tokens.usage: Second stripe of a redaction bar.

styles.name: page-title-lg
styles.usage: Title of a detail page (an issue).
styles.sample: Retry with backoff when RPC returns 429

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Title of a list or settings page.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings on a page, modal titles at 16px.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, descriptions, buttons (500).
styles.sample: Accept unlocks when the hidden-test run finishes.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, issue titles in rows.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints under fields, card subtitles, run times.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels and palette groups, uppercase.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Agent names, branches, commits, file paths, diff lines.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Issue IDs in rows and cards.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints, inside a 1px-bordered key with a 2px bottom.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs, icon to count.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between a mark and its text, label to field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, inline groups.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Gap in card headers; tab strip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid; modal inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; card header vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields; phone screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-4.5
tokens.usage: Card body padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page top padding; modal body padding (22 horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (22 on lists).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Main column side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Ratio bars and marks (half their height).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard keys, severity tags in diff notes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs, segmented items, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, nav items, menus items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inner panels (verdict box, run alert), toasts, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and the tables they hold.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Modals; phone cards; phone buttons at 12.

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: Phone frame in mockups.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Discs only: status glyph circles, count bubbles, switch tracks. Never pills of text.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card on the canvas: a hairline lift plus a long soft fall.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Centered modals and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the bulk-action bar.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Active tab, segment and nav item: a 1px ring instead of a border.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind glass sidebars and docks.
